notes: From Webs: news, polls, trivia, a countdown, a mystery box and more under the search box on the new tab page (Customize can hide it)
Calling cards, theme days and the wallpaper of the week, if you want it
Secret words and a secret code hunt in the address bar, and limited-time achievements
Games: a weekly leaderboard with a nickname you pick, community goals, and sometimes the owner's daily word
Help & support: common questions, problem reports with their answers, and rating the help
Safer updates: new versions can reach some computers first, and every computer can go back if one has a problem
Anonymous counts (the version and your country, never what you browse); turn them off in Settings
